# Fixture for the individual "subheading-relation" feature
# (see briefings/individual-SKOS-broader-relation.org).
#
# A 3-deep individual nest governed by one relation (skos:broader),
# plus a sibling subtree with a *different* relation (skos:related).
# Together these exercise:
#   - inheritance of the relation to arbitrary depth,
#   - the Facts target always being the *immediate* parent,
#   - per-subtree scoping/override of the relation,
#   - the declaring heading itself receiving no Facts.
#
# The top heading deliberately carries no CURIE, so no spurious
# resource frame is emitted for the ontology node itself; only the
# individual frames appear in the generated OMN.

#+title: SKOS subheading-relation test

* SKOS individuals test
:PROPERTIES:
:ID:       skos-test
:ELOT-context-type: ontology
:ELOT-context-localname: skos-test
:ELOT-default-prefix: ex
:END:

** Prefixes
:PROPERTIES:
:prefixdefs: yes
:END:

| prefix | uri                                  |
|--------+--------------------------------------|
| ex:    | http://example.org/skostest#         |
| skos:  | http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core# |

** Individuals
:PROPERTIES:
:ID:       skos-test-individuals
:resourcedefs: yes
:END:

*** Animal (ex:animal)
:PROPERTIES:
:ELOT-subheading-relation: skos:broader
:END:

**** Mammal (ex:mammal)

***** Dog (ex:dog)

*** Colour (ex:colour)
:PROPERTIES:
:ELOT-subheading-relation: skos:related
:END:

**** Red (ex:red)
